exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean after 2 cesarean deliveries
late preterm delivery (34-37 weeks of gestation)
Failed trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
lower rates of previous successful vaginal delivery
outcome: Success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies attempting trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) after 2 previous cesarean deliveries
finding: Late preterm delivery and cervical dilation on admission for labor <3 cm were associated with higher odds of failed trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) among women with 2 previous cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Late preterm delivery and cervical dilation on admission for labor <3 cm were associated with higher odds of failed trial of labor after cesarean.
